short_description: Regal's PLF brand. Larger screen and louder audio than standard, but DCI-baseline brightness, lowest contrast in the branded PLF tier (1,850:1), and no unique imaging capability.

default_projection.effective_resolution_label: 33,000-lumen single 4K projector; xenon at many locations — override to standard_4k_laser where confirmed laser
default_projection.contrast_notes: 1,850:1 published contrast — lowest sequential contrast figure in the branded PLF tier, below standard xenon DCI (~2,000–2,600:1). Brightness derived at 14–17 fL on a large 60 ft-wide screen (33,000 lumens at gain 1.0–1.2); 14 fL used as conservative floor.

default_sound.system_name: 7.1 Surround or Dolby Atmos (varies by location)

known_limitations: 1,850:1 contrast — lowest in the branded PLF tier, worse than standard xenon DCI
Brightness at DCI baseline (~14–17 fL on full-size screens) — no meaningful premium over standard
Screen size varies significantly (45–75 ft wide); some RPX rooms are barely larger than a standard auditorium
Projector type inconsistent — xenon at many locations, laser only at recently renovated sites
No proprietary aspect ratio, no HDR, no unique imaging capability
